prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t honestly name one single “best” — that depends on your exact location in Houston, whether it’s a home or business, how quickly you need service, and your budget. I can help you find the best option for your situation. A few quick questions:

- What ZIP code or neighborhood are you in?  
- Is this for a home or a commercial property?  
- Is it an emergency (no cooling right now) or routine repair?  
- Any brand/type of equipment (e.g., Trane, Lennox, Goodman)?

If you want a quick starting point, some Houston companies that commonly get strong reviews and are worth checking are:
- John Moore Services  
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (Houston branch)

(Those are examples — I can look up top-rated local options for your ZIP and compare.)

How to pick the best company (quick checklist):
- Confirm they’re licensed in Texas (check TDLR HVAC license) and have EPA 608 certification for refrigerants.  
- Look for NATE-certified technicians.  
- Read recent Google/Yelp/Angie’s/Bing reviews and check the BBB rating.  
- Ask about diagnostic fees, flat-rate vs. time-and-material pricing, and whether the estimate is written.  
- Ask about parts and labor warranties and if they honor manufacturer warranties.  
- Check emergency/after-hours availability and typical response time.  
- Get 2–3 written estimates before committing; beware of very low bids.

If you give your ZIP code and whether it’s urgent, I’ll pull up 3–5 top-rated local HVAC companies, summarize reviews/credentials, and recommend the best fit.
